[3] Robbie Williams is the only artist who has had three different number albums in a year in Germany—"Reality Killed the Video Star" hit the top of the charts in January, his greatest hits album "In and Out of Consciousness: The Greatest Hits 1990–2010" hit number 1 in October, and "Progress", on which he sang as a member of Take That, hit number 1 in December.
